items.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Original Mandarin lesson art for HANZI.OS, wide 3:2 soft painterly editorial art, jade teal and warm wood. In a small modern study room two closed books are clearly separate side by side on a desk, with a simple doorway in the background. A small clean room-number sign above the doorway reads exactly '203' in three plain Arabic digits. No other books anywhere, no other text, no people, no logos, no watermark. Main desk and exactly two books in central crop-safe area. Educational contrast: count two books versus reading a three-digit room number. Show all objects fully, calm natural daylight.

Use case: illustration-story. Original HANZI.OS Mandarin lesson wide landscape illustration with three equal vertical panels, one consistent young adult across all three, muted jade teal and warm cream with soft painterly editorial finish. Left panel: student attending a Mandarin class in morning daylight, blank classroom board without text, seated with notebook, teacher gesturing. Center panel: same student resting on sofa at home in afternoon light. Right panel: same student meeting a friend in a park in daylight, friendly greeting. Panels distinguish activities clearly with subtle thin separators. No text, no clocks, no numerals, no day names or speech bubbles. No brand or watermark. This illustrates a weekly plan whose exact weekdays will be stated as real text outside the image, do not invent written timetable.
